body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. PR #1032 exact merge `ab655fbbaf5c0091f24653e66e8e1a40b8fdfeeb`, reviewed head `10c76da90fcfd367706a9ad423f31c017a48f52c`, closed producing issue #419. This is a bounded additive reproduction erratum for exactly its 224 original IDs, maximum two PRs.

Two executed reproduction defects in `data/regional-review/regional-review-ce7798317652c0c2/build_assessment.py`:

1. The retained DZS summary workbook is consumed without an expected whole-file SHA256 guard. The source GeoJSON and detailed roster extract have hardcoded guards; the summary workbook does not. A complete private alternate workbook changing only county English label B10 on sheet `1.` from `Zagreb` to `AUDITOR_SYNTHETIC_COUNTY_ENGLISH` (whole 56,286 bytes SHA256 `0a214eb21f46b5d2ea133e9e7739d830a0186d394db8df2ae5445f8a8227636a`) was accepted by the original parser/assessment. It published the synthetic value as official county English in both summary JSON and province CSV, with changed product hashes, without declaring source drift. The true retained workbook is 63,196 bytes SHA256 `99feecc93627db02509aee7d625b391c33a69f201f377464ac15c2fd7c16f20f`. This is a missing immutable-input guard, not evidence that the actual retained DZS values are wrong.
2. The documented reproduction points `--output-dir` at the retained historical `vintages/2026-10-05` directory. The runner uses overwrite-mode CSV opens and JSON `write_text`, without refusing existing report destinations. In an isolated private directory containing three existing report-name sentinels, the actual runner silently replaced all three with regenerated reports. This risks erasing prior dated evidence. Original repository reports were not altered during the audit.

Reproduce from exact merge, immutable baseline `7646e0962afab6cc4f566439bb2f96890ae4b91e` and complete upstream HRV geometry SHA256 `68a317129a0c295fd8baf7acc0f31ffefdf65ff2f1f62f8ed90a765cc57cf01e` (20,788,018 bytes/560 features). These exact source bytes already exist read-only at merge `96f2a6d201236ba62f471535db240b123de60c09` in `data/regional-review/regional-review-c64d17e99f61d668/source/geoboundaries-9469f09/HRV/ADM2/geoBoundaries-HRV-ADM2.geojson`; independently verified hash equals the upstream immutable LFS pin. No new institutional fetch or source substitution is needed. Execute the unchanged original module `build(...)` twice, choosing fresh private output directories; compare all complete output bytes to the original reports. For the summary control, redirect only its exact workbook input to the complete fixture, keeping the original `read_xlsx_sheet` parser and builder; for preservation, prepopulate the three exact report basenames only in private scratch and call the unchanged builder with that output directory. Never run controls against retained originals.

Two original runs were byte-exact against all three retained products: summary JSON 10,913 bytes SHA256 `c5118a9046d10babfeab755e4f3dfbc09d9f5a35269a006820d3b27082c1a467`; province CSV 1,448 bytes `7a46977bafc709cab611f2b0b21fe890c3e8ffdcd067c494f7465424c1abba37`; subject CSV 167,059 bytes `91d12e56fa600e4cbeebdc7d12c82f131aded59a8a38a3d87eb8ed8f64429420`. Changed-summary results were JSON 10,939 bytes `c66c91ba9b2c0e8e63b9bcd527ad8248e49372fb059c51b6037abc1ded0585f6` and province CSV 1,474 bytes `bfc4344a9dfbd1b99ab796a1130704f91cec43fa980505a6cb4bc066a024d616`; subject CSV stayed identical. A whole GeoJSON plus newline correctly failed its original source pin before outputs; do not claim all guards fail.

Independent complete whole-world verification confirms 49,625 unique IDs, all 224 native subjects and all eight complete county roster counts. Independent native summary-workbook parsing with openpyxl 3.1.5 and the complete 555-row retained detail extract confirms 220 name/type matches, four sourced name candidates, 231 official versus 224 scoped units/seven missing rows, 19 source MultiPolygons and 13 type differences. County membership remains inherited, not independently proven. These correct historical results must be preserved.

Whole execution phase: 245,714,946 bytes including all 36 original geography parts, hierarchy/index and two compressed baseline registry pins, all 21 packet objects, whole source geometry, every fully read/CRC-verified summary ZIP member and 8 MiB reserve. The full summary-fixture control admission is 246,016,747 bytes; every ordinary/decoded member is below 32 MiB, every complete phase below 256 MiB. Do not bypass caps by streaming, splitting or sampling inputs.

Success criteria:

- Preserve all original dated reports, workbook/source bytes, code, issue scope and stable 224 IDs. Changes only in this new owned prefix. Provide an additive corrected reproducer/instructions, not edits to the original packet, neighboring packets or shared geography.
- Bind the exact reviewed baseline commit and complete immutable input/scope identities, including the summary workbook and every actual containing/index input. Do not self-pin arbitrary supplied bytes as expected evidence or equate a matching row count with exact scope.
- Reject the changed whole summary fixture and a genuine scope/identity drift before output creation; guard source objects with expected whole SHA256. Test supported inputs and contextual hashes honestly.
- Refuse an existing report destination before replacing any retained output; require a reviewed fresh named vintage, write outputs exclusively and preserve original hashes. Include a real sentinel test and interrupted/partial-output preservation behavior appropriate to the writer.
- Reproduce the three correct historical results twice with the original immutable evidence, recording complete pins, actual code/parameter/output identities and independent exact-head review. Make remaining sources/legal/geometry limits explicit. Do not claim DZS detailed-workbook extraction was independently verified without the full original workbook.

Readiness: #419 is closed, its canonical author reservation released, exact source bytes are already available with verified expected hash, and all 62 whole baseline/packet/source pins below are accessible. Complete open/closed issue pagination and open PR/body inspection found no owner or duplicate of this prefix/224-subject reproducibility defect. Related #1161/other Yugoslavia reproducer tasks own different packets and scopes; do not reopen or alter them. No implementation reservation is taken. This additive mechanical task needs no newly acquired official polygon or primary rights decision.

Keep #1028 (seven missing units) and #1029 (17 name/geometry-lineage subjects) open/blocked with their existing ownership: their producing dependency is satisfied, but lawful dated official boundary/lineage evidence remains unavailable. The full 18,279,747-byte DZS detail workbook is absent from GitHub-retained evidence, so its extraction and primary reuse notice authentication remain unverified. Current OSM/CC BY-SA source rights, independent county parents, official island/boundary completeness and shared area purpose remain unresolved. No boundary approval, new IDs, import, release, publication, merge or deployment follows from this erratum. Audit a corrective PR separately.
